_comment: Empty list = accept all. Max 64 IDs/bus; up to 32 IDs as exact filters in the MCP2518FD (CAN-A),
TWAI (CAN-B) gets one combined mask, the rest is discarded in software.
Bus 0 = CAN-A = vehicle CAN. Bus 1 = CAN-B: on the Model Y Juniper from SOP10
(Berlin from 2026-04-01) the right A-pillar port carries party CAN instead of chassis CAN.
IDs/layouts from Model 3/Y DBCs (repo dbc/, opendbc, joshwardell) - NOT verified on Juniper.
